name: Hemphill Foods, LLC
old_description: Locally owned and operated, Hemphill Foods has been serving customers in Mississippi and surrounding states since 1946.
about:
Founded in 1946, Hemphill Foods, LLC has operated from Jackson, Mississippi as a family-owned distributor for the food service industry. The business began as a local supplier serving customers across Mississippi and surrounding states, building relationships with independent operators over decades.

The company's product catalog centers on pickled products, chicken wingettes marketed as party wings, and carry-out containers available in one- and three-compartment configurations. While specific warehouse dimensions and employee counts are not public, the firm notes that its staff collectively holds over 150 years of food service experience, informing product selection and customer support.

Hemphill Foods targets restaurants, catering companies, and institutional food service providers throughout the Gulf South region. Its inventory emphasizes ready-to-serve proteins and disposable packaging suited for takeout and delivery operations.

The ownership highlights its family-owned structure and local presence as key differentiators, asserting that this perspective helps them understand the needs of their customers' end diners. The company's stated mission is to help food service businesses succeed through reliable product access and personalized service.
